text: The delegation of authority rows are read from rwb-access (P4) through one published REST read with a fake, and never from a copy in rwb_decision; the level, the delegation row id and the version in force are held on the approval row that routing stamps and on the D5 entry, and no rank, level or limit is written in code.
why: The P7 ownership rows hold no delegation table, the legacy read the level in process, DP-07 names the rwb-case contract and the connection matrix gives P7 one REST cell to P4; the build cannot start until one home is fixed.
read: Context pack P7 ownership rows; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-07 and R3; Architecture v5 slide 13; legacy RWB-E2-006 sections 4 and 12
confirm: P7 solution architect and the Ownership Map owner at the next map version
impact: One contract owner and one call path only; every criterion, level, version and the 2 s budget stay unchanged

text: The level required for a decision is read as GET /api/recovery/access/v1/doa-limits with decisionCode, regulationItem, productGroup, amount and asOfDate, answering the level, the delegationLimitId and the limitVersion, or NOT_COVERED with an incident to the risk queue; the read is one hop with a 2 s timeout and a circuit breaker that refuses rather than guesses, and MSG-P7-010, MSG-GEN-006 and MSG-P4-003 are issued with the text of the next message catalogue.
why: The story cannot enforce the delegation of authority without the current level, the row that set it and its version, and no source gives the path, the parameters, the answer or the two message texts.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-006 sections 4, 12 and 14; FSD P7 A2.24 AC-ALT-P7-024-01 and AC-EXC-P7-024-04; Template and Rules R4
confirm: P4 and P7 contract owners at the rwb-access contract review
impact: One operation shape and two message texts only; the level check, the version stamp and every criterion stay unchanged

text: A D5 entry holds the level NLEADS returned in approval_level and, in its actions payload, the required level, the delegation row id, the version in force, the NLEADS reference and the result date; inputs_ref carries the reference of the pack read the result rests on; the NLEADS reference is 1 to 30 letters, digits and dashes as the legacy story assumes it until SCB IT confirms.
why: TSD P7 T3.1 gives one approval_level column and a free jsonb actions field, so the two levels and the reference have no defined place, and the legacy marks the reference format assumed.
read: TSD P7 v2 T3.1; legacy RWB-E2-006 sections 11 and 12; FSD P7 A2.3 and A2.4
confirm: P7 solution architect and the ledger owner at the record schema review, with SCB IT for the reference pattern
impact: Keys and one pattern only; the decision code, the final call, the levels, the version, the reference and the dates are unchanged, and no column is added to another schema

text: The two recording operations declare the Decision log right A with the scope applied, as TSD P7 T-A.2 has them, while the Treatment and offer right U stays on the pack and result endpoint of rwb-integration; a caller without the right is refused with MSG-P4-002 and nothing changes.
why: The legacy operation requires one right and the target operation is declared with another, and the RBAC matrix has no A rows at all, so one of the two declarations must be chosen for the build to start.
read: Legacy RWB-E2-006 sections 10 and 12; TSD P7 v2 T-A.1, T-A.2 and T6.1; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-08
confirm: P4 access owner and the P7 solution architect at the access model review
impact: One right per operation only; the refusal, MSG-P4-002 and every criterion stay unchanged, and no role gains a right beyond the recording path

text: A credit result is recorded through the approve and refuse operations on the D5 approval row of the treatment, with source_type CREDIT_APPROVAL and source_ref the treatment id, one result per approval: NLEADS APPROVED maps to the approve operation and REFUSED to refuse with its reason.
why: The Ownership Map carries no credit-result operation on P7, and the routing slice creates the approval row, so the mapping from the legacy action to the owned operations has to be stated for the story to be testable.
